    patient_id            VARCHAR,     -- join key -> patient.patient_id
    encounter_id          VARCHAR,     -- join key -> encounter.encounter_id

    code_system           VARCHAR,
    display               VARCHAR,
    status                VARCHAR,
    period_start          TIMESTAMP,
    period_end            TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE diagnostic_report (
    diagnostic_report_id  VARCHAR PRIMARY KEY,
    patient_id            VARCHAR,     -- join key -> patient.patient_id
    encounter_id          VARCHAR,     -- join key -> encounter.encounter_id
    code                  VARCHAR,
    code_system           VARCHAR,
    display               VARCHAR,
    category              VARCHAR,
    status                VARCHAR,
    effective_date        TIMESTAMP

sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS report_count
            FROM diagnostic_report dr
            JOIN condition c ON dr.patient_id = c.patient_id
            WHERE dr.code = '34117-2' AND dr.code_system = 'http://loinc.org'
              AND c.code = '59621000' AND c.code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
